# About
Triple G Roofing & Construction is a small, local, family-owned and operated father-and-son company based in Humble, Texas, serving the Greater Houston area since 1973. Glenn and Tim Menn are the men behind the business. Owner Tim Menn is on every job personally to oversee the work and make sure everything is done as agreed. The company describes itself as serving clients "anywhere from Orange to Galveston and sometimes beyond."

Triple G handles roofing and the rest of the home's exterior: roof replacement in architectural shingle and metal, roof repair, roof inspections, hail, wind and hurricane damage repair, insurance-claim assistance, attic venting, gutters, siding (including Hardie/fiber-cement and vinyl), fascia and soffit, wood-rot repair, exterior paint, patio covers (including enclosed and screened patios), pergolas, wood decks, fences and gates, window re-sealing, interior sheetrock repair tied to exterior work, and thatch-to-metal palapa conversions. Inspections and written estimates are free. Triple G was voted a Nextdoor Neighborhood Favorite in 2022, 2023 and 2024.

# Services — Detailed

## 1. Roof Replacement
Full architectural-shingle and metal roof replacements across the Greater Houston area: tear-off, decking repair where rot is found, underlayment, new roof, and a clean job site when the crew leaves. Customer reviews describe crews covering landscaping, vegetable gardens and pools with tarps before work, working from sun-up to sun-down, cleaning up daily, and running a large magnet to pick up nails. Triple G installs major shingle brands such as GAF and also installs metal roofs on homes, barns and shop buildings. Attic ventilation is addressed as part of a replacement because shingle manufacturers can void or limit the shingle warranty when the attic is not properly ventilated. Every replacement starts with a free written estimate after the roof is measured in person.

## 2. Roof Repair
Leak repairs, flashing and pipe-boot fixes, shingle replacement and rotted-decking repair that stop water damage before it spreads. Reviews describe Triple G locating leaks that other roofers could not find (the source is often far from where water shows inside), and fixing related problems — vent pipes, drainage, squirrel damage, overgrown limbs — at the same visit.

## 3. Roof Inspection
Free, photo-documented roof inspections that catch early wear, record storm damage and produce a clear written estimate. Customers mention that Tim climbs onto the roof and takes exact measurements rather than estimating from the ground, and that he shows photos of everything he finds.

## 4. Storm & Wind Damage Roof Repair
Hail, wind and hurricane damage repair (customers have reviewed post-Hurricane Beryl replacements), with help through the insurance claim process from beginning to end. Temporary tarping may be available on request. Triple G documents the damage, explains the policy and meets the adjuster on the roof. Coverage decisions belong to the insurance carrier.

## 5. Roof Damage Repair
Assessment and repair for aging, worn or compromised roofs: wood rot, failed flashing, damaged decking and worn shingles.

## 6. Attic Venting
Balanced intake and exhaust ventilation that lowers attic heat, protects shingles and helps cut cooling costs in the Texas climate. Plainly stated: shingle manufacturers can void or limit the shingle warranty when the attic is not ventilated to their specification, so Triple G checks ventilation on every roof it replaces.

## 7. Gutter Installation
New gutters and downspouts that move water away from the foundation and protect fascia and soffit from rot. Often paired with a new roof or a new patio cover.

## 8. Siding, Fascia & Soffit
Siding repair and replacement (Hardie/fiber-cement and vinyl), fascia and soffit, wood-rot repair, window re-sealing, exterior paint, and interior sheetrock repair tied to exterior work. Reviews describe siding repaired on all sides of a home with paint matched, and a single project that combined a cedar fence, gate, roof leaks, sheetrock, window sealing, siding and exterior paint.

## 9. Patio Covers, Pergolas & Decks
Custom patio covers with shingle or metal roofs, enclosed and screened patios, cedar pergolas and wood decks built to match the home, plus thatch-to-metal palapa conversions. Because Triple G is a roofing contractor, the tie-in between a new patio cover and the existing roof is flashed and integrated properly. Reviews describe a patio roof extension with trim matched perfectly and a metal patio cover.

## 10. Fences & Gates
Cedar and pine privacy fences, ranch rail and custom gates — new builds, repairs and replacements. Reviews describe new backyard gates, fence repairs and privacy-fence replacement.

# Insurance Claims Experience
In the company's own words: "We have over 50 years of Claims, Claims Handling/Adjuster and insurance Knowledge/Experience. We are able to assist you in the entire claims process from beginning to end and take the stress and worry from your plate to ours."

What that means in practice:
- Triple G inspects and photographs the damage and provides a written record.
- Triple G explains the homeowner's policy in plain English.
- Triple G meets the insurance adjuster on the roof to walk the same damage together.
- Triple G helps the homeowner through the process from start to finish.
- Whether a claim is covered, approved or paid is always the insurance carrier's decision. Triple G does not promise coverage or outcomes.

# Process
- Free inspection or estimate for every job.
- The owner is on every job personally to oversee the work and make sure everything is done as agreed.
- No job is too big or small.

# Common Questions (Expanded)

**How long has Triple G Roofing & Construction been in business?**
Since 1973. Triple G has served the Greater Houston area for more than 50 years as a family-owned father-and-son team (Glenn and Tim Menn).

**Where is Triple G located?**
Triple G is based in Humble, Texas, and operates as a service-area business across Greater Houston. It does not publish a street address.

**What areas does Triple G serve?**
The Greater Houston area — from Orange to Galveston and sometimes beyond — including the 50 communities listed in the Service Area section.

**Are inspections and estimates free?**
Yes. Triple G offers free inspections and free written estimates.

**Does Triple G help with insurance claims?**
Yes. Triple G brings more than 50 years of claims, claims-handling and adjuster experience, documents the damage, explains the policy in plain English and meets the adjuster on-site. The coverage decision is always the insurance carrier's.

**Does Triple G install metal roofs?**
Yes — metal roof replacements on homes, barns and shop buildings, as well as shingle roofs, and thatch-to-metal palapa conversions.

**Does Triple G do siding, gutters, patio covers, decks and fences?**
Yes. Roofing, siding, gutters, patio covers, decks and fences — one call. Siding work includes Hardie/fiber-cement and vinyl, fascia and soffit, wood-rot repair, window re-sealing and exterior paint.

**Why does attic ventilation matter for a new roof?**
Balanced intake and exhaust ventilation lowers attic heat and protects shingles, and shingle manufacturers can void or limit the shingle warranty when the attic is not properly ventilated. Triple G addresses ventilation as part of a roof replacement.

**What warranty comes with the work?**
Shingles carry a manufacturer warranty. Ask Triple G for the workmanship guarantee terms for your specific project.

**Who will be on my job?**
The owner, Tim Menn, is on every job personally to oversee the work and make sure everything is done as agreed.

**What hours is Triple G open?**
Monday through Saturday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed Sunday. Call (281) 824-5463.
